descriptions.en: A read-only Home Assistant custom integration for Kibble pet care records.
descriptions.ko: Kibble 반려동물 케어 기록을 읽기 전용으로 연결하는 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다.

description.en: The pet care server used by this integration and the source of its brand icon.
description.ko: 이 통합이 연결하는 반려동물 케어 서버이자 브랜드 아이콘의 원본입니다.

categories_review.source: Kibble pet-bound state:read API exposes feeding, weight, medication and care records (README.md and custom_components/kibble/api.py). pets is the primary product/use category; no secondary category is needed. Reviewed 2026-10-23.
